International Cheese Federation Blog Archive
This page from the International Cheese Federation website archives blog posts from June 2019. It features a 'Member Spotlight' on a cheesemonger detailing their international supply chain and an article explaining the scope and target audience of the 'Certified Cheesemonger' retail credential.

Member Spotlight 

 

 

 



Yuri Lee 




 


A cheesemonger crosses the Atlantic 

 

One of our newer members runs a small cheese counter that buys direct from a handful of overseas producers. She told us what that supply chain actually looks like week to week.

Certification 

 

 

 



Yuri Lee 




 


What the Certified Cheesemonger credential covers 

 

Certified Cheesemonger is our entry-level retail credential. Here’s what the exam actually tests, who it’s built for, and what it doesn’t cover.
